description: Achievement/Badge system - horizontal progression that rewards milestones. Follows the same pattern as the collection system: a definitions file, an ops file, a component, and a system. Achievements are triggered by polled state (item counts, donation counts, structure counts, quest completions, fish caught totals) and one-time events (first harvest, first fish). Each badge has an i18n title/description key and a coin reward. All 12 locales updated.
steps: Create packages/game-engine/src/achievements/achievementDefinitions.ts with AchievementDefinition interface (id, titleKey, descriptionKey, rewardCoins, condition type union: {kind:'collect', itemId, count} | {kind:'donate', count} | {kind:'build', count} | {kind:'quest', count} | {kind:'fish', count} | {kind:'total_coins', amount}). Define 8-10 achievements: first_harvest, first_fish, collector_5 (donate 5), builder_10 (build 10), quest_master (complete 3 quests), big_spender (earn 200 coins total through quests/sales), fish_master (catch 10 fish), full_gathering (complete gathering collection category).

Create packages/game-engine/src/achievements/achievementOps.ts with pure functions: checkAchievement(state, definition, source) -> boolean, unlockAchievement(state, achievementId) -> boolean, getUnlockedCount(state) -> number. The source interface provides item counts, donation count, structure count, quest completion count, fish caught count, total coins earned.

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/AchievementComponent.ts extending Component with type 'achievement'. Fields: unlocked Set<string>, pendingReward string|null, version number, totalFishCaught number, totalQuestsCompleted number.

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/AchievementSystem.ts that polls achievement conditions each frame (like QuestSystem polls quest progress). On unlock: sets pendingReward for the wallet system to pay out, bumps version. Requires components: ['achievement', 'inventory', 'wallet', 'collection', 'quest'].
Register AchievementComponent in packages/game-engine/src/components/index.ts and AchievementSystem in packages/game-engine/src/systems/index.ts. Export from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts.

Add i18n keys for all achievements in apps/web/src/i18n/messages/en.ts (achievement.title, achievement.unlocked, achievement.{id}.title, achievement.{id}.description for each). Update all 11 other locale files with translated equivalents.

Create packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/achievements.test.ts with comprehensive tests: each achievement condition triggers correctly, double-unlock prevention, reward payout, system processes entities correctly, edge cases (zero progress, already unlocked).
Run pnpm format && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test to verify everything passes.
acceptance_criteria: AchievementComponent, AchievementSystem, achievementDefinitions, and achievementOps exist and follow ECS patterns
8-10 achievement definitions with i18n keys that resolve in all 12 locales
Achievement unlock is idempotent (cannot unlock twice)
Each achievement condition is testable via the polled source interface
pnpm build passes with no TypeScript errors
pnpm test passes including new achievement tests and existing i18n parity test
